sources.title: OFAC FAQ401
sources.supported_claim: Indirect ownership depends on intermediate blocked ownership, not multiplication of percentages. Native scope deliberately excludes this complex method.

sources.title: OFAC FAQ398
sources.supported_claim: Ownership50percent rule does not automatically treat control alone as blocking; other program criteria may differ.

sources.title: OFAC FAQ5
sources.supported_claim: Lists and programs carry different prohibitions. Authorizations, exemptions, blocking versus rejection and record/report obligations depend on applicable regulations.
